installCommand: if [ -f package.json ]; then COREPACK_ENABLE_DOWNLOAD_PROMPT=0 corepack yarn install --immutable; else (cd frontend && COREPACK_ENABLE_DOWNLOAD_PROMPT=0 corepack yarn install --immutable); fi
buildCommand: if [ -f package.json ]; then corepack yarn build && rm -rf frontend/dist && mkdir -p frontend/dist && if [ -d out ]; then cp -r out/. frontend/dist; else cp -r dist/. frontend/dist; fi; else (cd frontend && corepack yarn build); fi
